# AI Local Business

> AI Local Business, by Spencer Scott Digital, gets local service businesses found on Google, Google Maps and AI search like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and builds websites that turn those searches into calls. We work in Bergen County, New Jersey and Brevard County, Florida, and with local businesses anywhere else we can help.

In Bergen County, New Jersey, Spencer works with contractors, home services and other local businesses in towns like Glen Rock, Ridgewood, Wyckoff, Paramus, Hackensack, Teaneck and Fair Lawn. In Brevard County, Florida, Andrew works with local businesses on the Space Coast, including Melbourne, Palm Bay, Cocoa Beach, Titusville and Rockledge.

Our core services include Google Business Profile setup and optimization, fast website builds, local SEO, ChatGPT business profile setup, and AI search optimization (AEO), helping businesses become the answer when customers ask AI tools for local recommendations.

Contact: spencerscottdigital@gmail.com | New Jersey (Spencer): (201) 903-3491 | Florida (Andrew): (904) 540-6181 | Website: https://ailocalbusiness.biz
